dct_description_sm: Data was collected in order to determine a sediment budget for the West River through the identification of areas of net sediment erosion, transport, and deposition.  Through the monitoring of the major inflows to the river, it would be possible to determine the quantity of sediment provided by major active layer detachments.  Sediment fluxes were measured at five locations along the West River, along with five inflows from tributaries with various levels of disturbance.  All other inflows were mapped and sampled where sediment transport was noted.
dct_title_s: 2010 West River Sediment Budget data, Cape Bounty
